# Arrawiya Alzahabia Hotel — فندق الرؤية الذهبية
# (formerly known in English as Golden Vision Hotel; the Arabic name is unchanged.
#  The domain, the building sign and some booking platforms still show Golden Vision.)

> A hotel in the Al-Firdaws District of Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia.
> Bilingual site (Arabic / English). All prices include 15% VAT and the 2.5% lodging fee.

## Contact
- Website: https://goldenvisionhotel.com
- Phone: +966 13 891 0999
- WhatsApp: +966 53 509 9958
- Email: goldenvisionhotel@outlook.sa
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/8va98KpJgwdjJUX29
- Check-in 11:00 AM · Check-out 2:00 PM
- Free parking for 30+ cars (basement and behind the hotel)

## Room types and current prices (SAR per night, tax and fees included)
- King bed room — 135 (was 220)
- Twin bed room — 150 (was 250)
- Triple room, 3 beds — 170 (was 270)
- King bed room with living room — 185 (was 300)
- Family unit, two rooms and two bathrooms — 210 (was 350)
- Family suite, two rooms with living room — 280 (was 400)
- Accessible room, mobility (grab bars, roll-in shower chair) — 150 (was 250)
- Accessible room, hearing (sign-language screen, visual alerts, help phone, Braille-labelled amenities) — 150 (was 250)

## Amenities
Free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, in-room coffee and tea, mini-fridge in suites, elevator,
free parking, rooms adapted for guests with mobility and hearing needs,
a lobby heritage corner displaying traditional Saudi antiques.

## Payment methods
mada, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Tamara, bank transfer.
